text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Keselamatan

Sosial Pekerja (Perbekalan Tambahan bagi Tahun 2020) 2021.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan tambahan bagi tahun 2020

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi tujuh puluh enam juta ringgit

(RM76,000,000) daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial bagi perbelanjaan

tambahan untuk pentadbiran Rancangan Keselamatan Sosial bagi tahun 2020

adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Harta, loji dan kelengkapan 76,000,000

Jumlah 76,000,000

Dibuat 10 Februari 2021

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)58/XXIII]

DATUK SERI M. SARAVANAN

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (ADDITIONAL SUPPLY FOR THE YEAR 2020)

REGULATIONS 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 72 of the

Employees' Social Security Act 1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security

(Additional Supply for the Year 2020) Regulations 2021.

Issue for additional expenditure for the year 2020

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding seventy six million ringgit (RM76,000,000)

from the Social Security Fund for the additional expenditure on the administration of the

Scheme of Social Security for the year 2020 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified

in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purposes Amount

(RM)

Property, plant and equipment 76,000,000

Total 76,000,000

Made 10 February 2021

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)58/XXIII]

DATUK SERI M. SARAVANAN

Minister of Human Resources
